summary: Complete frontend testing of MAZA Vienna static one-page site on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). All specified data-testid elements present and functional. Hero content fully visible after animations settle (opacity 1). Scroll-reveal sections all reach opacity 1. Menu tabs, gallery lightbox, mobile menu, header nav smooth-scroll all work. Reservation form validation shows correct German errors; valid submission to LazyForms returned success state (res-success visible). No console errors, no horizontal overflow on either viewport.

issues: Header background is already dark (rgba(7,30,25,0.85)) at scrollY=0 — the spec described 'transparent -> dark' transition on scroll. Backgroundcolor did not change between top and scrolled state. Minor: visual is still on-brand but the scroll state change is not visible.

detailed_verification.reservation_valid_submission_result: res-success visible=True, res-error visible=False (LazyForms POST succeeded from container)
detailed_verification.mobile_menu: toggle opens fullscreen menu, nav-galerie triggers scroll, mobile-menu-close closes menu

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: If the design intent is a transparent-at-top header that darkens on scroll, currently the header uses the dark rgba(7,30,25,0.85) even at scrollY=0. Consider setting bg to transparent while !isScrolled in Header.jsx.
OPTIONAL: Consider auto-closing the mobile menu after a nav link is tapped (current behavior: menu remained open after nav-galerie click).
critical_code_review_comments: No critical issues. Code composition is clean: Lenis smooth-scroll wraps sections, Reveal uses whileInView, MaskedLines animates on mount — hero content is guaranteed to reach opacity 1 without depending on IntersectionObserver.
Reservation form correctly POSTs multipart/form-data to LazyForms and gracefully handles both success and error states (verified success path in this environment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 requested test items verified on both desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. Only two optional/cosmetic notes: header does not visually transition transparent->dark on scroll, and mobile menu does not auto-close after nav tap. No JS crashes, no console errors, no horizontal overflow.
